title: Meeting — shared definitions for the vtc/events/meeting/* spec family
description:
A Verifiable Trust Community's meetings (VTI Community Events chapter, VTI-EVT-255 – 268): an event of kind `meeting` with an agenda, a chair and a secretary, a roll call taken from its check-ins, a quorum that gates motions, motions decided by the community's own elections, minutes and action items. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

A MEETING IS AN EVENT. Everything here hangs off an event of kind `meeting` (`vtc/events/_shared/0.4` `EventKind`); every meeting task refuses an event of any other kind. Nothing a meeting records confers authority (VTI-EVT-002): a motion's effect is its election's, and the election's own rules decide it.

MeetingAgendaItemId.title: MeetingAgendaItemId
MeetingAgendaItemId.description: Opaque identifier of one agenda item: `agi_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters, unique within its meeting.

MeetingMotionId.title: MeetingMotionId
MeetingMotionId.description: Opaque identifier of one motion: `mot_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters, unique within the community.

MeetingActionItemId.title: MeetingActionItemId
MeetingActionItemId.description: Opaque identifier of one action item: `act_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters, unique within the community.

MeetingLink.title: MeetingLink
MeetingLink.description: Something an agenda item or an action item points at: a board idea, an election, a record in the meeting's room, or a web page. Exactly one of the members names it.

boardIdeaId.description: A board idea, by its identifier (`vtc/boards`).

electionId.description: A community election, by its identifier.

roomRecordId.description: A record in the meeting's room, by the identifier the room gives it.

url.description: A web page, by its `https` address. No other scheme.

MeetingAgendaItem.title: MeetingAgendaItem
MeetingAgendaItem.description: One item of a meeting's agenda (VTI-EVT-256). The agenda is the ordered list of these.

title.description: What the item is. Plain text.

owner.description: Who leads the item, by entry.

done.description: Marked done by the chair or the secretary. Absent means false.

MeetingRole.title: MeetingRole
MeetingRole.description: `chair`: runs the meeting — the agenda, the motions, the minutes' approval. `secretary`: records the minutes and the action items. Each held by appointment (VTI-EVT-257); a meeting has at most one chair and one secretary.

MeetingQuorumRule.title: MeetingQuorumRule
MeetingQuorumRule.description: How many must be present for the meeting to decide (VTI-EVT-260). Exactly one of `count` and `fractionPercent`. `of` names who counts: the meeting's roster (those registered and going) or, with `role`, the community's active members holding that role.

of.description: `roster`: counted against the meeting's registrants who are going. `role`: counted against the community's active members holding `role`.

fractionPercent.description: At least this percentage of those counted, rounded up.

MeetingQuorumStatus.title: MeetingQuorumStatus
MeetingQuorumStatus.description: Where the quorum stands now, read from the roll call (VTI-EVT-258, VTI-EVT-261).

present.description: Those present who count toward the rule.

eligible.description: Those the rule counts against, where the rule is a fraction.

required.description: How many must be present for quorum.

MeetingMotion.title: MeetingMotion
MeetingMotion.description: A motion: a question the meeting puts to a community election (VTI-EVT-262). Its standing — open, closed, its result — is the election's, read from the election, never copied here.

agendaItemId.description: The agenda item it belongs to.

electionId.description: The community election that decides it.

presentAtOpening.description: Those present toward quorum when it was opened.

MeetingMinutesState.title: MeetingMinutesState
MeetingMinutesState.description: `draft`: recorded, not yet approved; may be recorded again. `approved`: approved by the chair, fixed; a correction is a later record (VTI-EVT-265).

MeetingMinutes.title: MeetingMinutes
MeetingMinutes.description: A meeting's minutes (VTI-EVT-265): where they are kept and whether they are approved.

roomRecordId.description: Where the minutes are kept in the meeting's room, where it has one.

text.description: The minutes themselves, where the meeting has no room. Plain text.

MeetingActionStatus.title: MeetingActionStatus
MeetingActionStatus.description: `open`: to do. `done`: done. `dropped`: no longer to do.

MeetingActionItem.title: MeetingActionItem
MeetingActionItem.description: Something a meeting asked a member to do (VTI-EVT-266). The assignee's own agent may show it in their calendar (VTI-CAL-024).

title.description: What is to be done. Plain text.

assignee.description: Who is to do it, by entry.
